method: Independent visual inspection of all 25 listed actual displayed BMPs through the image viewer. Every local BMP size and SHA-256 was recomputed against the audited artifact member before saving this receipt. Independent GDI oracle rasters were not reviewed as application screenshots.
conclusion: No additional visible layout defect found in the unobscured selected captures. Both path cases visibly retain wrapped bold names and regular descriptions, readable token and maximum-description endings, one workflow node and real SAMtools guidance. Spaces-path overflow/collapse endpoints remain populated. Ordinary-path overflow was unreached in this run after the runner console took foreground; acceptance remains incomplete for that gate.
limits: Static screenshots do not establish absence of transient flashing; sampled temporal/native gate reports supply that separate evidence.
Only hosted Windows and the captured DPI/window sizes were reviewed. No high-DPI, multi-monitor, representative-PC or screen-reader acceptance is claimed.
Ordinary-path overflow/collapse screenshots were not produced by this run and were not substituted with older candidate captures.
A visible workflow node does not by itself prove the pointer input, node count or keyboard behavior; use the tied native gate reports.
The partially visible first/last lines in scrolled intermediate views are viewport clipping; complete-line union coverage is checked separately by the native wrapped gate.
The ordinary feedback failure image is obstructed by the runner console and cannot support an application flashing/layout conclusion.
